title: fix(verify): a from-model stock's source is judged unless the user marks it raw stock only
body:
## What changed

**The default verdict is unchanged.** If the user does nothing, every non-fixture model is still judged as the part, exactly as before. A casting copied into a "from model" stock and left in the tree leaves the gouge verdict only when the user ticks **"The source model is raw stock only (not judged as the part)"** on the stock page (shown for a from-model stock).

The first push of this PR guessed which model was the part. The review reproduced a real 5 mm gouge posting with an empty gate (a stock made from the part itself, plus an unrelated model an op touches, live or suppressed). That guess is removed. The rule is now explicit:

- `SetStockSourceOnly` (new, `crates/app/src/commands/stock_source_only.rs`): one undoable step on the active setup's stock. It is refused by name when the stock is not made from a model. It writes `schema::StockSourceOnly { source }` on the stock entity.
- MCP `set_raw_stock_only { on }` (`crates/app/src/mcp/setup_tools.rs`) runs the same command.
- UI: a checkbox under the stock page's Source picker (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/raw_stock_row.rs`), which queues `CommandKind::SetRawStockOnly`.
- Project file: optional `raw_stock_only` on the stock row, absent = false. No version bump: an older reader drops the key and judges more, never less. An unmarked document saves as before.
- **The mark is self-validating (third review).** The mark carries a 128-bit fingerprint of the source model's geometry as the verdict reads it (`crates/app/src/stock_print.rs`). It covers the facet count, every vertex coordinate of the local facets as `f64` bits, and the model's placement bits, hashed two independent ways: FNV-1a and splitmix64.
  - `stock_source` honours the mark only while a model of that name exists, is still the stock's source, and prints the same. Any mismatch voids the mark: the model is judged.
  - A void mark adds a named note to the gate's visible, non-blocking line (status line, NC header, script/MCP `not_judged`) and to the stock page.
  - The facet hash is memoised per revision (`GeomPrintMemo`).
  - The project file saves `raw_stock_print` beside the flag. A flag with no print loads as unmarked, with a load note.
  - The per-command drops (now `DeleteEntity`, `DeleteFixture`, `UpdateModel`, `SetStock`) only keep the checkbox honest; safety no longer depends on them.
- **Per-command drops (second review).** `DeleteEntity` of the source model (or of the stock), `UpdateModel` (re-import in place, and `RepairModel` through it) and `SetStock` (any new stock, including the same model again) drop the mark inside their own undo step (`MarkDrops`, snapshotted at construction). Undo restores the model and the mark together. A model imported later under the old name inherits nothing. No model rename command exists. Project load sets the mark only when its source model is in the file; otherwise it is read as unmarked, with a load note. Binding the mark to the entity id or a geometry stamp was considered and dropped (decision file).
- `stock_source::stock_only_model`: the marked source leaves the verdict only while every stock the program starts from is a copy of that model and carries the mark. A new `SetStock` source drops the mark's hold. Any operation (any setup, suppressed included) that names the model in its source or in a boundary pick puts it back in the verdict.
- `posting_sim`: when the mark leaves no other model with a body (facets), the post is refused by name ("nothing is judged as the part: ..."). A gouge refusal whose worst gouge lies in a program stock's source model that no op names adds one sentence saying what the setting means: if that model is the finished part, the program cuts into it, and the box is only for a raw casting or blank. It also says why a mark did not hold. That hint is the only inference left, and it changes no verdict.

Decision record: `docs/decisions/1094-stock-source-not-part.md`. It covers the explicit rule (orchestrator's direction, taken unattended), the dropped inference and clause-by-clause patches, reader-side vs refusing the mark, and refuse vs warn.

## Other readers of "every non-fixture model"

| Reader | Changed? | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `simulate_document`, carry `judge`, field view, judged playback | yes, only when marked | all read `part_facets` / `parts_facets_in` |
| model-excess law `model_fidelity::verdict_tol` (#864/#911) | no | a coarse casting still tightens or refuses the verdict: a false refusal at worst |
| per-op collision / rapid / cross-drill laws | no | read the op's own source or the stock, not the document part set |
| rest material | no | reads the stock walk |
| alignment, picks, fixture clash, tree, GPU list | no | placement and display, not judgement |

## Tests

`crates/app/tests/stock_source_verdict.rs` (22, all pass). New for the third review:
- `delete_fixture_then_a_part_under_the_old_name_refuses_the_gouge`: the third review's reproduction.
- `the_print_alone_voids_a_mark_left_on_other_geometry_by_a_path_with_no_drop`: bypasses every drop on purpose (raw remove, reimport, stale mark put back by hand). It refuses with the note, and fails if the print check is removed (checked by mutation).
- `an_identical_re_import_under_the_same_name_keeps_the_mark`
- `a_moved_or_edited_marked_model_voids_the_mark_with_a_note`: MoveModel, its undo, and an in-place facet edit.
- `a_file_with_the_flag_but_no_print_loads_unmarked_with_a_note`

New for the second review:
- `a_model_imported_under_a_deleted_marked_sources_name_does_not_inherit_the_mark`: the second review's delete + re-import reproduction, which must refuse. It fails if `DeleteEntity` keeps the mark (checked by mutation).
- `undo_of_deleting_the_marked_source_restores_the_model_and_the_mark`
- `a_re_import_in_place_drops_the_mark_and_undo_restores_it`
- `a_stock_changed_to_a_box_and_back_comes_back_unmarked`
- `an_empty_model_is_nothing_to_judge`
- `a_file_whose_mark_names_a_missing_source_loads_unmarked_with_a_note`

From the first rework:
- `a_stock_made_from_the_part_with_an_unrelated_model_beside_it_refuses_the_gouge`: the review's reproduction 1, which must refuse (default).
- `the_same_with_the_unrelated_op_suppressed_still_refuses`: the review's reproduction 2.
- `marked_an_op_naming_the_model_puts_it_back_in_the_verdict`: marked, plus an op (suppressed) naming the part. The gouge still blocks, and the hint says why.
- `marked_a_boundary_pick_on_the_model_puts_it_back_in_the_verdict`: the review's item 3.
- `unmarked_the_casting_is_judged_and_the_refusal_says_how_to_mark_it`: the issue's job, off. It refuses, with the hint.
- `marked_raw_stock_only_the_casting_leaves_the_verdict_and_the_program_posts`: the issue's job, on. It posts.
- `marked_the_separate_part_stays_judged_a_cut_below_its_floor_blocks`
- `a_mark_that_leaves_nothing_to_judge_refuses_by_name`
- `the_mark_undoes_redoes_and_a_new_stock_source_drops_its_hold`
- `the_mark_is_refused_on_a_stock_not_made_from_a_model`
- `the_mark_round_trips_the_project_file_and_an_older_file_judges_as_before`

Other new tests:
- `mcp_setup::set_raw_stock_only_marks_the_stock_source_through_the_command`: same command, undo, refusals.
- ui `egui_app::tests::raw_stock_row::the_stock_page_ticks_raw_stock_only_through_the_command_and_undo`: AccessKit label click, undo. Structural, no PNG.

Suites green: `edge_break_gate` (5), `solid_law_goldens` (1), `stock_sim_document` (9), `operations` (117, 6 ignored), `golden_cl` (25), `project_roundtrip` (71), `post_not_judged` (4), `mcp` (13), `mcp_setup` (7). `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean. `camcraft-ui --lib structural` (4). `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: green, app and ui suites, 0 failed (11.4 min).

## Not exercised

- Multi-setup documents (aligned, or carried with "what the setup before leaves") with a marked casting. The rule reads them, but no test drives a spanned program.
- Model rename: no such command exists. The print check covers whatever geometry a future rename leaves under the marked name.
- The void note rides the gate's `not_judged` line, which is also the stock sim's "did not judge" channel. A void mark therefore reads as a note on that line, prefixed `note:`.
- The hint's "gouge lies in the source's bounds" test uses world bounds, so in an aligned (turned) setup the hint may be missing or misplaced. It is only a hint and changes no verdict.
- The GUI was not launched. The checkbox is proven by the kittest harness only.
- The camcraft-mcp skill's tool table (`.claude/skills/`, a process file) does not list `set_raw_stock_only` yet. Left out so this PR needs no `PROCESS_VERSION` bump.
- #1091's `stepped_stock_rapid.rs` still deletes its casting as a workaround. With this PR it could tick the mark instead (not touched here).

Changelog: A stock made from a model gets a "The source model is raw stock only (not judged as the part)" setting (stock page, MCP `set_raw_stock_only`, saved in the project). Ticked, a casting left in the tree is no longer judged as the finished part, so a legal program over a separate part posts. Off by default, so nothing changes until the user ticks it. A gouge on the stock's source now says where the setting is. (#1094)

Effort: high (no escalation; reworked after three reviews)

Fixes #1094
